name: Sword Coast
description: The region where a villainous wizard plans to wage war.

timeline.summary: Decades ago Sylvene comes from Ravnica to the Sword Coast, falls in love, and builds a demiplane refuge.
timeline.quote: She built a refuge for them in a small demiplane of her own creation

timeline.summary: The wizard starts a plan to conjure castles and muster mercenaries and armies to wage war on the Sword Coast.
timeline.quote: These are the early days of a plan to wage war on the Sword Coast

relations.note: The crypt commemorates her allies on the Sword Coast.
relations.quote: Many of those memories were celebrated and commemorated with the construction of a grand crypt in a verdant land

pages_say.description: The coast west of the High Moors in Faerun.
The region of Faerun where Sylvene lived for a time.
The region of Faerun where Sylvene adventured.
The region where a villainous wizard plans to wage war.
